major_cooldowns.name: Zenith
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: It has two charges, so you don't have to spend it the moment it's ready; time it around a burst window like Bloodlust, a trinket proc, or a heavy-damage phase.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 1249625 is both the cast and the self buff row in the ability table; talents can turn the listed 90s base into 60, 70 or 80 seconds.

major_cooldowns.name: Celestial Conduit
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Stagger it away from Strike of the Windlord and Whirling Dragon Punch so their Heart of the Jade Serpent buff instances don't overlap with its own, and hold it if you'd overlap the Zenith-triggered instance.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Only observed in 2/5 sampled parses; requires the Conduit of the Celestials hero talent.

major_cooldowns.name: Invoke Xuen, the White Tiger
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it a few globals ahead of when you want to channel Celestial Conduit so you aren't wasting a GCD on the summon during your burst window.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Only observed in 2/5 sampled parses; requires the Invoke Xuen talent choice.

major_cooldowns.name: Touch of Death
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it as soon as it's available without delaying a higher-priority cast; only hold it briefly if the target is about to drop under 15% health so you get the higher, health-based damage instead.

major_cooldowns.name: Whirling Dragon Punch
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it once Rising Sun Kick has enabled it; with Conduit of the Celestials, only use it when your next Invoke Xuen is at least 10 seconds away.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Build-dependent finisher choice among the Shado-pan and Conduit of the Celestials hero talent options.

major_cooldowns.name: Strike of the Windlord
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: With Conduit of the Celestials, only use it when your next Invoke Xuen is at least 10 seconds away, and stagger it from Celestial Conduit so their Heart of the Jade Serpent buffs don't overlap.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Build-dependent finisher choice among the Shado-pan and Conduit of the Celestials hero talent options.

rule.description: Open Tiger Palm into Zenith, Fists of Fury, Rising Sun Kick
rule.action: Open with Tiger Palm, then send Zenith with your potion and trinkets, then Fists of Fury into Rising Sun Kick.

rule.description: Whirling Dragon Punch needs a recent Rising Sun Kick
rule.action: Land Rising Sun Kick first; it enables Whirling Dragon Punch, so pressing it without a recent Rising Sun Kick wastes the cast.

rule.description: Hold Whirling Dragon Punch and Strike of Windlord for Xuen
rule.action: Delay these until Invoke Xuen is at least 10 seconds from being ready so you don't burn them right before your Xuen and Celestial Conduit window.

rule.description: Blackout Kick is your filler inside Zenith
rule.action: Fill with Blackout Kick while Zenith is up to pull Rising Sun Kick and Fists of Fury back faster, and only weave in Tiger Palm when you need the Chi.

rule.description: Don't overcap Chi with Tiger Palm
rule.action: Skip Tiger Palm when you're already sitting on plenty of Chi and spend a builder or filler instead.

rule.description: Spinning Crane Kick only pays off on several targets
rule.action: Shift into Spinning Crane Kick once you have several targets up; on a single target press Blackout Kick or Tiger Palm instead.
